overview_description.description: Skillza is a creator of an educational technology platform meant to maximize learning results. The company's platform enables educational institutions to incorporate new technology into classrooms to improve the learner-centeredness of their classrooms, enabling students to gain the opportunity to work on their skills and core competencies.
